dedupe_keys.name: fifty metre walkability gis grids for 59 european urban centres

description: This separate Mendeley Data release contains high-resolution spatial walkability indicators for fifty-nine European city centres. The producer says seventeen built-environment attributes were calculated on fifty-by-fifty-metre grids from street-observation vectors using the ArcGIS kernel-density tool. Version 2 lists a single ZIP named walk_datahub_all_cities_v2.zip, described as shapefile grids, under CC BY NC 3.0. The article originally cites version 1 and mentions GeoJSON preview through a web GIS; the current repository inventory does not separately list GeoJSON files. These processed grids describe selected central districts and are not a complete pedestrian network or observed person-level travel. Kernel-density construction, study boundaries and the non-commercial licence are limitations for reuse. A reviewer-assessed use is mapping candidate pedestrian-environment conditions in city-scale active-mobility simulations. data-openstreetmap is a related network base, without verified cell-to-street matching. The distinct centre-level workbook is G2-0612. No archive was fetched.
